title: Study of the Mechanism of Xianglian Anchang Decoction Ameliorating Ulcerative Colitis Based on Transcriptomics and Network Pharmacology Analysis.
authors: Gao, Tianyu; Zhao, Cuimei; Lu, Lishan; Luo, Ziyue; Wang, Chen; Ma, Junzhuo; Ren, Xuetong; Xu, Xiaosong; Chen, Jiong; Lv, Jingjing; Zhang, Shixiong; Yang, Qian; Wang, Yangang
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药香连安肠汤通过IL-17/AP-1信号轴改善溃疡性结肠炎，虽含分子对接与MD模拟，但核心是药物-蛋白互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且转录因子AP-1仅作为信号通路下游靶点，未涉及TF-DNA结合机制。
abstract: INTRODUCTION: The therapeutic efficacy of Xianglian Anchang Decoction (XLAC) in Ulcerative Colitis (UC) has been established, but the underlying pharmacological mechanisms have remained poorly elucidated. In this study, we employed an integrated strategy combining network pharmacology, transcriptomic profiling, and in vivo experimentation to reveal these mechanisms, with a particular focus on how XLAC modulates the IL-17/AP-1 signaling axis to attenuate intestinal inflammation and promote mucosal repair. METHODS: UC was induced in mice by 2% Dextran Sulfate Sodium (DSS) administration in drinking water. The animals were randomly divided into five groups: control (untreated), model (DSS only), XLAC-L (12.4 g/kg/day XLAC extract), XLAC-H (24.8 g/kg/day XLAC extract), and sulfasalazine reference (SASP) (5 g/kg/day sulfasalazine reference drug). Following a 7-day treatment period, various parameters were evaluated, including body mass fluctuations, colon dimensions, microscopic tissue alterations, and intestinal barrier integrity biomarker levels. A computational target prediction analysis was performed to elucidate the pharmacological mechanisms of XLAC, with subsequent transcriptome sequencing verification. Analytical techniques including fluorescence-activated cell sorting, protein immunoblotting, and tissue staining were employed to investigate the modulatory impact of XLAC on UC via the IL-17/AP-1 molecular cascade. Molecular docking and molecular dynamics simulations were performed to evaluate constituent-target binding and complex stability. RESULTS: XLAC significantly prevented DSS-induced body weight loss, preserved colon length, and reduced the severity of colonic histopathological injury. The XLAC intervention suppressed the secretion of inflammatory mediators such as IL-6 and TNF-alpha, while concurrently promoting the expression of the tight junctional protein ZO-1. Integrated network pharmacology and transcriptomic profiling identified the IL-17 signaling pathway as a potential mechanism underlying the therapeutic effect of XLAC against UC. Further experiments validated that XLAC decreased IL-17A levels and inhibited both the expression and phosphorylation of the AP-1 transcription factors c-Jun and c-Fos. Molecular docking revealed stable binding between the principal bioactive constituents of XLAC (beta-sitosterol and quercetin) and the c-Jun/c-Fos protein complex. Molecular dynamics simulations demonstrate the structural stability of the beta-sitosterol-c-FOS complex. DISCUSSION: Our findings reveal a critical role of the IL‑17/AP‑1 signaling axis in the pathogenesis of Ulcerative Colitis (UC) and demonstrate that XLAC may exert its therapeutic effects through this pathway. The multi‑target regulatory mechanism of XLAC provides a molecular basis for its superior efficacy and fewer side effects compared with conventional single‑target therapies. These data support the potential of XLAC as a candidate drug for UC treatment. CONCLUSION: XLAC exerted protective effects against UC by regulating the IL-17/AP-1 signaling pathway, suppressing the inflammatory responses, and promoting intestinal mucosal barrier repair. These findings provide a mechanistic basis that supports the clinical application of XLAC in UC treatment.
abstract_zh: 引言：香连安肠汤（XLAC）对溃疡性结肠炎（UC）的治疗效果已得到证实，但其潜在的药理学机制尚未得到充分阐明。在本研究中，我们采用了一种整合策略，结合网络药理学、转录组学分析和体内实验来揭示这些机制，特别关注XLAC如何调节IL-17/AP-1信号轴以减轻肠道炎症并促进黏膜修复。方法：通过在小鼠饮用水中给予2%葡聚糖硫酸钠（DSS）诱导UC。动物被随机分为五组：对照组（未处理）、模型组（仅DSS）、XLAC-L组（12.4 g/kg/天XLAC提取物）、XLAC-H组（24.8 g/kg/天XLAC提取物）和柳氮磺吡啶参考组（SASP）（5 g/kg/天柳氮磺吡啶参考药物）。经过7天治疗期后，评估了各种参数，包括体重波动、结肠尺寸、微观组织改变和肠道屏障完整性生物标志物水平。进行了计算靶点预测分析以阐明XLAC的药理学机制，随后通过转录组测序进行验证。采用包括荧光激活细胞分选、蛋白质免疫印迹和组织染色在内的分析技术，研究XLAC通过IL-17/AP-1分子级联对UC的调节影响。进行了分子对接和分子动力学模拟，以评估成分-靶点结合和复合物稳定性。结果：XLAC显著预防了DSS诱导的体重减轻，保持了结肠长度，并降低了结肠组织病理损伤的严重程度。XLAC干预抑制了炎症介质如IL-6和TNF-α的分泌，同时促进了紧密连接蛋白ZO-1的表达。整合网络药理学和转录组学分析确定了IL-17信号通路是XLAC抗UC治疗效果的一个潜在机制。进一步实验验证了XLAC降低了IL-17A水平，并抑制了AP-1转录因子c-Jun和c-Fos的表达和磷酸化。分子对接揭示了XLAC的主要生物活性成分（β-谷甾醇和槲皮素）与c-Jun/c-Fos蛋白复合物之间的稳定结合。分子动力学模拟证明了β-谷甾醇-c-FOS复合物的结构稳定性。讨论：我们的研究结果揭示了IL-17/AP-1信号轴在溃疡性结肠炎（UC）发病机制中的关键作用，并证明XLAC可能通过该通路发挥其治疗效果。XLAC的多靶点调节机制为其相比传统单靶点疗法具有更优疗效和更少副作用提供了分子基础。这些数据支持XLAC作为UC治疗候选药物的潜力。结论：XLAC通过调节IL-17/AP-1信号通路、抑制炎症反应和促进肠道黏膜屏障修复，对UC发挥保护作用。这些发现为XLAC在UC治疗中的临床应用提供了机制基础。
